Increases the Defense of all allies for 2 turns, and decreases the chance of them receiving Critical Hits.

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
Critical Hit Rate against the monster is reduced by 50%

competences.description: Increases the Attack Bar of allies by 10% whenever your turn ends. Additionally increases the Attack Bar by 5% based on the number of beneficial effects granted on the target, up to 20%. If the other allies have harmful effects, increases their HP by 5% based on the no. of harmful effects, up to 30%. This effect does not have an effect on allies that have similar skill effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
